description: This Java class 'Config' is part of the OFBiz framework and handles server startup configuration. It loads properties from configuration files, initializes parameters such as directories, network addresses, ports, locale, and timezone, and sets system properties accordingly.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: A final class managing server parameters needed during startup, such as directories, addresses, ports, and properties. It reads configuration files, initializes parameters, and sets system properties.

methods.name: isShutdownAfterLoad
methods.description: Indicates whether the server should shutdown after load.

methods.name: isUseShutdownHook
methods.description: Indicates if shutdown hook is enabled.

methods.name: getOfbizHome
methods.description: Returns the path to the OFBiz home directory.
